purpose: Find recent empirical releases and overlooked public products useful for testing the acceleration-vacuum relation and resolving existing measurement systematics
status: Data-readiness scout. No new fit, cross-match, empirical preference or significance calculation was performed.
search_window: Priority to March 18-October 18, 2026 publications and releases; older available raw products retained when prior project work used only derived tables.

ranked_candidates.name: FAST All Sky HI Survey DR2
ranked_candidates.paper: Chuan-Peng Zhang et al., The FAST All Sky HI Survey DR2: the FASHI Catalog and the HI Mass Function
ranked_candidates.paper_version_history: arXiv 2606.31539 v1 June 30; v3 July 10, 2026. Full-text column description inspected in v1; actual September data headers inspected separately.
ranked_candidates.sample: 156411 extragalactic HI detections, z < 0.09; 28352 ALFALFA cross-matches in companion table
ranked_candidates.access_checked: HTTP 206 partial reads succeeded. Full README, catalogue header and first rows verified. No full-catalogue row count independently recomputed.
ranked_candidates.project_coverage: Existing local records mention DR1 and one unresolved tidal-dwarf field; no DR2 ingestion or analysis was located in the searched data_assembly, campaign_fresh_gravity and prep_2026 Markdown records.
ranked_candidates.best_next_use: Cross-match existing MIGHTEE and SPARC targets to obtain a third flux comparison alongside ALFALFA; then assess whether gas-dominated, isolated, well-inclined galaxies can provide a new acceleration normalization sample.
ranked_candidates.local_dependency: campaign_fresh_gravity/CFG304_mightee_flux_scale_alfalfa/README.md reports a -0.195 dex median MIGHTEE-catalogue/ALFALFA flux offset in 15 code-1 matches. A new survey can investigate this systematic; it does not automatically resolve it.
limitations: 2.9 arcmin beam: global line widths are not resolved outer rotation speeds
Requires independent optical inclinations and stellar masses for BTFR use
HI extraction ellipse is not intrinsic optical morphology
Distance, confusion, linewidth extraction and selection effects remain
Raw/reduced cubes are not provided as an unrestricted public reduced-cube release in the paper

ranked_candidates.name: MUSE-ALMA Haloes multi-tracer kinematics and baryon census
ranked_candidates.recent_publication_dates: Kinematics journal article published September 30, 2026; data-release, kinematics and baryon-census preprints posted together October 7, 2026. Data-release journal article appeared in April 2026.
ranked_candidates.recency_caveat: Do not call all underlying cubes newly released in October. Public directory listings show February 2026 file modification times; those times alone do not establish first public availability.
ranked_candidates.sample: 79 galaxies in parent survey; six galaxies with detailed multi-tracer study at 0.43 < z < 0.83, four classified as discs
useful_products: CO and ionised-gas kinematics in the same galaxies
Public naturally and Briggs-weighted CO FITS cubes, masks and primary-beam products
ranked_candidates.access_checked: ALMA public portal and actual per-field file listing fetched successfully; Q0454-220 directory lists 15 and 60 km/s cubes and README. Large FITS cubes were not downloaded.
ranked_candidates.table_checks: Inspected kinematics Tables 1-3 in arXiv HTML: galaxy properties, fitted kinematic/mass parameters with asymmetric uncertainties, and stellar dynamical estimates are present.
ranked_candidates.project_coverage: No matching titles, arXiv identifiers, Barfety author or MUSE-ALMA Haloes ingestion found in searched local Markdown records.
ranked_candidates.best_next_use: Calibrate tracer-dependent pressure-support corrections by fitting CO and ionised-gas data to a shared gravitational potential, with baryonic masses constrained independently of the kinematic decomposition.
limitations: Four modelled discs, not a large precision sample
Most kinematics probe approximately 1-2 effective radii, not guaranteed asymptotic flat velocities
Reported Vcirc, fitted baryonic masses and dark matter fractions are coupled model outputs; do not treat them as independent raw measurements
Atomic HI masses are inferred using optical/absorber relations or surface-density assumptions, not spatially resolved 21cm measurements
CO-to-H2 conversion, stellar masses, inclination and environmental selection remain systematic uncertainties

ranked_candidates.name: MHONGOOSE full-depth data cubes rather than profile catalogue alone
ranked_candidates.release_status: Official page lists deep releases 1, 2 and 3 and states they jointly contain all sample galaxies. Exact first-publication date of release 3 was not authenticated.
ranked_candidates.verified_products: 55-hour-per-galaxy full-depth cubes and moment maps, 1.4 km/s channel spacing, multiple angular resolutions
ranked_candidates.project_coverage: CFG540 examined Veronese 2026 radial HI profiles for 16 galaxies. Its conclusion that no rotation curves were available applies to that catalogue; the public cubes are a separate opportunity.
ranked_candidates.best_next_use: Recover independent outer HI kinematics and baryonic gas profiles beyond conventional detection thresholds, selecting regular discs without SPARC overlap.
limitations: Not a verified new post-March release date
Cubes require new tilted-ring modelling and quality checks
Deep diffuse HI may be warped or non-circular and cannot automatically extend equilibrium rotation curves
Stellar photometry, distances and inclinations still required

secondary_candidate.name: Zhou et al., An HI study of a large sample of ultra-diffuse galaxies
secondary_candidate.sample: 112 ultra-diffuse plus 48 low-surface-brightness HI-detected galaxies; 168 non-detections used for stacking
secondary_candidate.potential_use: Gas-rich, low-surface-density stress test of normalization and sample universality
secondary_candidate.checked: Primary full HTML including BTFR methodology and machine-readable table statement; full numerical supplement access not verified
limitations: Based on FASHI DR1/ALFALFA, not an independent third survey
Unresolved W20 and optical inclination are uncertain velocity proxies
Reported offsets are a challenge to assess, not positive evidence for the project
Overlap with existing UDG samples must be checked before treating objects as independent

deprioritized.name: KiDS-Legacy
deprioritized.reason: Useful public shapes, covariance and redshift products, but first release predates requested recent window; project already uses KiDS extensively.

deprioritized.name: WALLABY Pilot DR2
deprioritized.reason: Already ingested; official release September 2024, despite 2026 papers describing it.

deprioritized.name: BIG-SPARC
deprioritized.reason: No newly downloadable release authenticated in this search.

deprioritized.name: eROSITA DR2
deprioritized.reason: New catalogue release verified, but catalogue-only products do not directly provide the independent resolved gas and mass profiles most needed here.

deprioritized.name: Repackaged SPARC and multi-survey corpora
deprioritized.reason: New packaging does not create independent measurements; use original survey products.

search_scope_and_limits: Primary survey portals, arXiv, journal releases and public repository listings, cross-checked against local inventories and selected existing lane reports. Local coverage search was bounded to relevant data_assembly, campaign_fresh_gravity and prep_2026 records; absence of a match is not proof that no other chat ever considered a source. No authors contacted, full survey catalogues or large cubes downloaded, or new empirical claims fitted.
